title: Tilt & Turn uPVC Windows
whatIsIt: A dual-function window on a Z-sash hardware set: tilt inward from the top for secure ventilation, or turn fully open on a side hinge for cleaning and full airflow.
whyChooseIt: One window, two modes — crack it open on tilt for ventilation you can leave unattended, or swing it fully open when you want maximum airflow or need to clean the outside glass from indoors.
idealFor: Windows that are hard to reach from outside

benefits.title: 100% opening capability
benefits.description: The turn mode opens the sash fully on its side hinge.

benefits.title: Secure tilt ventilation
benefits.description: Tilt mode allows airflow while keeping the window in a locked, restricted-opening position.

benefits.title: Easy to clean
benefits.description: Fully turns inward so outer glass can be cleaned without external access.

designOptions: Single or twin-sash configurations with the Z-sash tilt-and-turn hardware set.

series.description: Features a Z-sash configuration enabling 100% opening in turn mode, plus a secure tilt mode for controlled privacy and ventilation.
